reservedComponents.reason: Source includes generated revenue/MRR/code/dashboard filler. Kept out of the main film to honor the uncluttered, no-UI direction. Available if a later component choice changes that direction.

timingNotes: WordStream uses fixed phrase rhythm for editorial headlines only, never as a claim of transcript-aligned captions. Actual audio timing is pending.
WordPush source helper omits the additional one-frame offset in the final push; allow helper + 1 frame for complete settlement.
MaskRevealUp locally adapted to clipped, clean line entry and held finish because supplied docs conflict with the registry source.
BlurOutUp locally adapted to crisp entrance; six-word, 150-frame sequence begins staggered exits at local 131, and four-word, 90-frame sequence at local 73.
Finite local Sequence duration is required for RollingNumber and BlurOutUp. Scene wrappers handle fades for components that hold their final state.

RollingNumber settles at 80% of its finite local Sequence, not a universal fixed frame. The report count now uses [24,120), settles at global 101, and holds through the transition. The zero group starts at 28, four frames after its sibling, and stays at zero.

craft.scope: Rules apply to authored scenes, typography, chrome and motion wrappers. Preserve prebuilt effect-specific tracking, blur, gradients and elevation. Previously documented local clean-entry/font adaptations remain explicit; no further flattening of registry effects.
craft.fontChoice: Instrument Serif 400 retained for Pramanik’s established editorial identity; Inter for body and JetBrains Mono for the registry counter. All fonts load once at module scope.
authoredStyle: Solid text colors; no gradient text
No decorative washes or blur blobs
Use a 1px neutral border or a single small neutral shadow only when separation needs it
No glow, stacked shadows, spread or decorative filter blur over 24px
motion: One primary focal action per beat
Sibling scene elements enter 3–6 frames apart; specialist nodes at 390/394/398, counter groups at 24/28
Parallel work starts together at 420 after staged entrances; this is meaningful concurrency, not simultaneous entrance clutter
Ease visible entrances and exits; use linear motion only for intentional constant drift
Preserve object continuity on the case path; follow-up return uses a curve
No bounce or overshoot added to authored motion
Animate translate/scale/opacity or SVG stroke progress; top/left/width/height are static layout only
No camera drift across text in current plan; if later introduced, promote one inner text container only, never Drift, a bordered card, or individual glyph spans
craft.determinism: Only frame-driven animation. No Math.random, Date.now, timers or CSS keyframe animations. If stochastic visuals are later needed, use an existing deterministic seeded facility; do not add a dependency without approval.
componentIntegration: Sequence durations account for full entry, settle, hold and exit; the source helpers determine minimum duration where available
Components remain transparent; scene containers own backgrounds
Use only actual declared props: no animation speed on UI primitives
Let shadcn resolve registryDependencies; import each installed component directly, not through uninstalled deep helper paths

transitions.current: Frame-driven fades and object continuity at existing scene boundaries. No TransitionSeries presentation is currently mounted or installed.
